title: Winning polls with a check and what winners owe listeners
summary: Sam says anyone with money can win a poll, and poll winners are judged by listeners.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience

blocks.x: But like I say man, I think if you could, like
anything else, get some money to the same people, there would be no problem for you winning the polls. See, just write a check, you see.
